author: GitHub
description:
Ever open a GitHub repository and find an empty README? Markdown is the secret to making your project look credible and helping others understand your code. From simple headers and lists to code blocks and screenshots, markdown is low effort but high impact. You will use it everywhere on GitHub, including pull requests, issues, and comments. 

Watch the full episode on our channel to learn markdown step by step: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxeclcePg-c
